items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: I'm a pretty good friend, you know.

ctx.x: He made some records with Wild Bill, you know. Yeah, Wild Bill did. He played with the band. That's right. Maury Stein, the writer on Hollywood, was writing a lot of tunes, you know. He writes a lot of tunes.
Uh-huh. Before I forget it, how did George Bernays get his first trombone?

He bought, he was supposed to buy my trombone for nine bucks. Yeah. And every time I see him, I say, when are you going to give me my nine bucks? He says, would you believe I got that same trombone and I ain't going to give you the nine dollars? He still got you? Yeah. That's the first horn you ever? Yeah. He tells me that all the time. I says, uh, I can't curse. I don't want to curse. Yeah. I say, hey boy, I says, when are you going to give me my nine dollars? I ain't going to give you nine dollars. I ain't…
